newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shidax ask-only on food poisoning reports.
newsitem.headline: Shidax ask-only on food poisoning reports.

text.p: Shares in Shidax Corp were ask-only in Tuesday morning trade on the over-the-counter (OTC) market, on domestic media reports that there had been food poisoning at a number of cafeterias the company operates, traders said.
At the end of the morning session, Shidax shares were ask-only at 4,650 yen, compared with Monday's close of 4,900.
A Shidax spokesman said there had been food poisoning at five cafeterias its operates for employees of three city banks.
"We think it was last Thursday's lunch, but we don't know what caused the poisoning. We have temporarily closed the cafeterias where the food poisoning occurred," he said.
A trader at a second-tier brokerage said: "News of food poisoning at a number of cafeterias operated by Shidax led investor sentiment to sell in small lots."
